nodes.name: AdminDashboard.css
nodes.summary: Admin dashboard layout with sidebar navigation, featuring forest-green theme, grid-based content structure, and responsive nav menu with hover effects.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet using CSS custom properties for theming (color-forest, color-gold, color-ink) and CSS Grid for layout.

nodes.name: BlogPageStyles.css
nodes.summary: Blog listing and detail page styles with gradient backgrounds, responsive typography using clamp(), and card-based grid layout for blog posts.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet with responsive typography using clamp() for fluid font sizing and auto-fill grid for card layout.

nodes.name: CreateAccountStyles.css
nodes.summary: Account creation page styles featuring a dark overlay background with centered form box, glassmorphism effects, and warm color palette.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet with backdrop-filter for glassmorphism effect and CSS Grid place-items for centering.

nodes.name: LoginStyles.css
nodes.summary: Login page styles with centered authentication form, overlay background, and consistent styling with create account page.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet for authentication form layout with overlay background pattern.

nodes.name: PlacesStyles.css
nodes.summary: Places and trips listing page styles with hero section featuring large typography, statistics display, and filtering controls.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet with responsive hero layout using CSS Grid and clamp() for fluid typography.

nodes.name: ProfileStyles.css
nodes.summary: User profile page styles with personal information display, avatar styling, and associated trip/review sections.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet for user profile layout and component styling.

nodes.name: WeatherWindowStyles.css
nodes.summary: Weather information window styles for displaying trip weather conditions with icons, temperature, and forecasts.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet for weather display widget with icon styling and data visualization.

nodes.name: NotificationModal.css
nodes.summary: Notification modal component styles with overlay backdrop, animated entry/exit transitions, and modal card with header and close button.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet with fadeIn animation, transform transitions for modal entry, and fixed positioning for overlay.

nodes.name: NotificationPopover.css
nodes.summary: Notification popover styles for displaying brief notification messages with positioning and animation effects.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet with popover positioning and fade animations for notification display.

nodes.name: PageNotFoundStyles.css
nodes.summary: 404 error page styles for displaying page not found message with appropriate messaging and navigation options.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet for error page layout and messaging styling.

nodes.name: ProfileDropdown.css
nodes.summary: Profile dropdown menu component styles with avatar display, animated menu entries, and hover effects.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet with fadeIn animation, dropdown positioning, and hover state transitions.

nodes.name: ProfileDropdownStyles.css
nodes.summary: Alternative profile dropdown styles with consistent avatar and menu styling, likely a variant or refactored version.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet variant for profile dropdown, may be consolidated with ProfileDropdown.css.

nodes.name: ReviewFormStyles.css
nodes.summary: Review submission form styles with text input area, star rating display, and action buttons for review submission.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet for review form with star rating styling and textarea transitions.

nodes.name: ReviewListStyles.css
nodes.summary: Review listing styles for displaying user reviews with author info, ratings, and review content cards.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet for review card layout and display styling.

nodes.name: TripStyles.css
nodes.summary: Trip display component styles for showing trip information including routes, waypoints, and trip details.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS stylesheet for trip information display and route visualization.

nodes.name: Profile.css
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder file for profile page styles. Styling may be handled by ProfileStyles.css or inline styles.
nodes.languageNotes: Empty CSS file, no styles defined.
